recent_changes.description: Applied code review fixes: In-process file lock (withFileLock), 2-pass batch embedding in ingest.ts, modular tools architecture in src/tools/, extracted pure mergeRrf() and built comprehensive mock unit test suite
Implemented v2.0 SQLite-Native Knowledge Graph engine with k-hop Recursive CTE, zero-token graph extractor, 3 graph tables, and 5 new enterprise MCP tools

decisions_made.decision: Use SQLite WITH RECURSIVE CTE for Graph Traversal instead of PostgreSQL/pgvector or Neo4j
decisions_made.reason: Maintains 100% zero-dependency local Node.js + TypeScript stack, executes graph traversal inside DB engine with pushdown computation and index optimization

decisions_made.decision: Implement in-process Promise queue file lock (withFileLock)
decisions_made.reason: Prevents lost-update race conditions when multiple concurrent agents append or write to the same note
Reduces HTTP request round-trip overhead from N+1 to 1 per file while keeping contextual retrieval flexible

decisions_made.decision: Split monolithic mcp-server.ts into domain-focused tool modules (src/tools/)
decisions_made.reason: Improves maintainability, readability, and isolates tool schema definitions from HTTP server transport setup
